findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only Nav.astro (11 lines, no test files), and the repo has no test runner configured anywhere (no vitest/playwright, no test script in package.json). The claim of written/run tests cannot be substantiated and appears false; at most this was manual browser verification, which the report should say explicitly.
